newsitem.title: USA: Converse sales for first 4-months $163.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Converse sales for first 4-months $163.5 mln.

text.p: Converse Inc said Monday its net sales for the first four months of 1997 were $163.5 million, a 48 percent increase from the same period a year ago.
The company said it saw increases in each of its four product categories: basketball, athletic leisure, children's and cross training.
The company also said its global backlog increased to a high of $227.9 million as of April 26. It is a 50 percent increase from $152.2 million for the same period a year ago.
The company also said it accepted a commitment leter of BT Commercial Corp to supply a new $150 million revolving credit facility.
The company said the new facility will replace its existing facility.
The company said the new credit facility will have a term of five years.
